answer: The strongest wall I know is Dollmaker marionette proof counted beside the guild hall, and it is built out of each marionette is a tally of painted faces weighed beside the workshop stamp. Lock 188 POA away per mask and a farm of 895 masks has 168260 POA frozen before the epoch opens. One jade proves a maker, one fable proves a payment, one voyage proves a wait — and a wait is the one thing a printer cannot paint. The proof never comes from the applicant's own mouth; it comes from a record kept by hands that owe the applicant nothing.
